rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still ~4.4% below VWAP ($8.82) and over 3% below the 9-EMA ($8.71), with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.78%, VIXY +2.72%) unchanged and the $8.68 invalidation unthreatened.
